evals.name: capture-does-not-interrupt
evals.setup: `srd:review` is mid-pass. The SRD claims "the gateway retries 3×"; two corpus searches find no document stating any retry count.
expected_behavior: Writes a light record — `detail`, `srd_ref`, and the `search_terms` from the failed lookups — to the per-SRD buffer and returns at once
Runs no grill and makes no `report_gap` call at capture time
Prompts the user for nothing: the caller's pass continues uninterrupted

evals.name: drain-grill-confirm-file
expected_behavior: Surfaces the count and the topics, and offers to work them now
Per gap asks light or heavy, assembles the record, and shows it
Files via `report_gap` only on the finder's yes, records the returned `gap-NNNN`, and drops the record from the buffer
On "keep going", leaves both gaps buffered and returns to the caller

evals.name: an-srd-gap-is-refused
evals.setup: A caller hands over "the SRD's §4 has no owner list" — a defect in the document, not in the platform documentation.
expected_behavior: Recognizes it as an SRD gap rather than a documentation gap
Tells the caller to keep it in their own findings

evals.name: opt-out-and-duplicate-merge
evals.setup: A second caller session hands over the retry-count gap already buffered for `SRD-42`, with different search terms. At drain the finder says "skip the questions".
expected_behavior: Merges into the existing record — wider `search_terms`, richer `detail` — instead of adding a duplicate
Takes only the one-line `detail` and leaves `target_claim` empty, honouring the opt-out
Still shows the record for confirmation before filing: opting out of the grill is not opting out of the confirmation

evals.name: terse-output-with-no-store
evals.setup: A buffer with one gap, against a server exposing neither `report_gap` nor `POST /gaps`.
expected_behavior: States once that filing is unavailable, notes the gap in the output, and leaves it buffered
No preamble; each fact stated once
No closing restatement of what was already shown
